items.name: setup-vite
items.title: Ultima setup for Vite
items.description: PROTOTYPE (ULT-8). components.json plus a vite.config.ts with the StyleX unplugin. Universal item: installs without Tailwind.
items.docs: Ultima on Vite: this replaced vite.config.ts with one that runs @stylexjs/unplugin before the React plugin and aliases @/ to src/. Add "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } to your tsconfig (the CLI needs it to place files), then run: npx shadcn add @ultima/button

items.name: setup-next
items.title: Ultima setup for Next.js App Router
items.description: PROTOTYPE (ULT-8). components.json, babel.config.js, postcss.config.js and the @stylex; stylesheet. Universal item: installs without Tailwind.
items.docs: Ultima on Next.js: StyleX compiles through babel.config.js (Turbopack picks it up) and extracts CSS through postcss.config.js. Import app/ultima.css from your root layout, then run: npx shadcn add @ultima/button
